requirements.description: Add tests that cover migrating the unique ID from both old formats (v1 pre-2023.9.0 and v2 from 2023.9.0) to the new address-based format

label.evidence: tests/components/airthings_ble/test_sensor.py (new file, ~213 lines): test_migration_from_v1_to_v3_unique_id (~:26) and test_migration_from_v2_to_v3_unique_id (~:66) each register an old-format entity, set up the entry, and assert the unique_id became "<address>_<sensor>". Extra tests cover v1+v2 together and all three IDs present. Supporting fixtures and helpers are in tests/components/airthings_ble/__init__.py.
label.notes: Reviewer asked for a test of migrating from both ID formats; the final diff adds one test per format plus two combination tests. Line numbers are approximate (counted from the diff). The same diff also refactors migrate() into async_migrate() and changes device lookup to Bluetooth connections only; that's beyond this comment, so I didn't score it (flags: base_drift_possible, resolution_time_unknown). Tests not run. One thing I noticed but did not score: the tests and async_migrate both pass DOMAIN and "sensor" to the entity-registry calls in what looks like the swapped order, consistently, so the tests agree with the code either way.
